tara_finance: Lumen invoice 1012005 shows full quarter platform_fee but they reduced nodes 5->3 effective 2026-05-12. Customer on PO hold, asking for correction.

rafael_billing: Pulling it now. Do we have amendment?

mia_contracts: Uploaded amendment 2026-04D on May 2, effective 2026-05-12. SOW says daily proration.

billing-bot: invoice-gen created 1012005 at 1775000001. amendment-sync status: failed for account lumen_corp due to transient API timeout.

rafael_billing: Likely the sync miss. Short term: issue credit memo and regen invoice. Legal sign-off needed for credit wording.

legal_sarah: Credit memo + corrected invoice is preferred. Include amendment id 2026-04D and note proration per SOW.

tara_finance: Please expedite. Customer expects resolution before EOD tomorrow. cc acctmgr@redwood and procurement@lumen.io

rafael_billing: Will draft CM and attempt targeted regen. If regen fails, CM will be issued and posted here.
